messages:
ashley: Heads up — seeing repeated p99 spikes on eu-west around 02:10 UTC. Looks like one tenant is saturating PCIe queues and causing downstream token latency (+10% tail across the rack). Anyone else?

samir: Yep, saw the same. Tenant 'animatorx' opened a lot of long-gen sessions ~02:06 and cache miss rate shot up. KV cache regen + PCIe util spike.

devon: Stack traces point to sustained batched requests (8k tokens/req pattern). Warm slots stayed pinned; other tenants got preempted and their p99 jumped to ~420ms from ~120ms.

ashley: Proposal: run a quick "isolation sweep" — temporarily quiet the noisy tenant (lower egress/routing weight) and proactively prewarm adjacent warm-pool slots to absorb spill. Keep the window short. Thoughts on thresholds?

sre-jen: Agree. Prefer soft-dedicated fallback (route to noisy-lane) before full dedicated carveout. Need a KV-miss x p99 signal for automation so we don't noisy-flag healthy bursty tenants.

samir: Quick cost check: soft-dedicated lane for an hour ~ est $12/hr extra for eu-west 3-slot carveout. Prefill cost negligible compared to SLA risk, but we need bounds.

devon: We can implement a safety rule: if p99>300ms && kv_miss_rate>0.35 for 3m then reduce tenant weight by 0.6 and prefill N=4 warmslots in same AZ. Rollback if p50 degrades >10%.

ashley: Good. Also prefer a cooldown: once quieted, prevent reflagging that tenant for 30m to avoid oscillation.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-4012 — Noisy-tenant detection triggered for animatorx in eu-west-1. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/noisy-tenants

sre-jen: Action items: 1) devon -> run isolation sweep now and report, 2) samir -> PR for router auto-quiet rule + rollbacks, 3) ashley -> dashboard with kv_miss x p99 and a heatmap by AZ.

devon: Kicking off sweep: draining 3 pods from rack euw1-rack42, prewarming 4 warmslots in euw1-b. Command I'm using (dry-run first):
```
# prefill warmslots
api post /warmpool/prefill -d '{"az":"euw1-b","slots":4,"ttl":600}'
# reduce routing weight
curl -X POST https://router.internal/api/v1/weights -d '{"tenant":"animatorx","delta":-0.6}'
```

ashley: ETA on the sweep?

devon: ETA ~12m. I'll post p99 and kv_miss after.

samir: I'll start the PR template for auto-quiet with toggles for cost center and manual override. Include metric emitters for noisy_reason and prewarm_cost_est.

ashley: Thanks — if sweep stabilizes p99, we'll formalize the rule. If not, escalate to soft-dedicated carveout. Keep notes of any cross-AZ spill. :thumbsup:
